title: Search images
placeholder: Search filenames, or type format:jpg album:"Album name"
fixedAlbum: Fixed scope: current album {name} (ID {id}). Clearing the query keeps this scope
displayTimezone: Filters use this timezone; image card dates use your browser’s local timezone
cameraHint: camera:"Canon EOS" searches the same text in camera or lens metadata
sizeHint: Use decimal MB, e.g. 0.000001MB = 1 byte; up to 6 decimal places
dateHint: Upload dates: YYYY-MM-DD; after includes the day, before excludes the day
helpTooltip: Search with keywords and conditions; click for syntax and examples
helpIntro: Words search filenames. Space-separated conditions use AND; comma lists in format and album match any value
albumTemplate: The example album “旅行” is a template. Edit it or select your own album from suggestions
replaceWarning: This replaces the entire query draft. Results stay unchanged until you search
quoting: Wrap complete text in double quotes when it contains spaces, colons or special characters. Inside quotes, only \" and \\ escapes are supported. Words match literal substrings; AND / OR / NOT are ordinary words
limits: Up to 4096 UTF-8 bytes, 32 tokens, 8 distinct keywords, 200 code points per text and 5 resolved albums. Scalar fields cannot repeat; format and album merge repeated lists
dateBoundary: Dates refer to uploads. after includes local midnight; before excludes local midnight. For October: after:2026-10-01 before:2026-11-01. The server handles daylight saving time
security: Search stays within your account and the current page’s authorized scope. Private images are hidden from public listings; direct links may still be accessible
aliasIntro: The open-source admin interface uses extension / is / order:earliest, utmost, least; enterprise v1 archives use order:created_at[-asc]. ImageNest accepts only these aliases and normalizes them on submission
aliasRules: extension still means the actual stored format. is accepts only public/private; order accepts only the five listed values. Admin fields such as name, group, strategy, email and ip are unavailable. $ is a literal filename character

explain.format: Actual stored format: jpg png gif webp avif bmp tiff svg heic heif unknown; jpeg→jpg, tif→tiff. Independent of filename extension. Commas mean any
explain.album: Exact album name, #positive ID, or unfiled; comma lists allowed. Quoted "unfiled" and "#42" are names
explain.camera: One literal substring in camera or lens metadata. Images without EXIF do not match
explain.minsize: Inclusive minimum, MB required; 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes
explain.maxsize: Inclusive maximum, MB required; 0–1024000 MB, up to 6 decimal places
explain.before: Exclusive local upload-date end; must be later than after
explain.visibility: all / public / private. all does not expand permissions
explain.sort: newest / oldest / size-desc / size-asc / name-asc / name-desc. Default newest, with a stable ID tie-breaker

error.unknownField: Unknown field. Choose a supported field; quote the entire filename if it contains a colon
error.missingValue: Missing value. Add text after the colon or inside the quotes
error.unclosedQuote: Unclosed double quote. Add the closing quote
error.invalidEscape: Invalid escape. Only double quotes and backslashes can be escaped inside quotes
error.unexpectedCharacter: Unexpected character. Use an ASCII colon and quote complete text values
error.emptyListItem: Empty list item. Remove the extra comma or whitespace after it
error.invalidEnum: Unsupported value. Choose from suggestions or the syntax help
error.invalidDate: Use a real YYYY-MM-DD date between 1970-01-01 and 9999-12-31
error.invalidSize: Size requires MB, a value from 0 to 1024000, and at most 6 decimal places
error.duplicateField: Repeated scalar condition. Keep one; only format and album lists can merge
error.rangeConflict: Conflicting range. Minimum size must not exceed maximum; after must precede before
error.queryTooComplex: Query exceeds the length or condition limits. Shorten it
error.controlCharacter: The query contains a disallowed control character. Remove it
error.invalidTimezone: Invalid date timezone. Use a valid IANA timezone
error.albumNotAvailable: Album unavailable. Select one of your accessible albums
error.albumAmbiguous: Multiple albums have this name. Select a suggestion with its ID
error.dateNotRepresentable: This date does not exist in this timezone. Choose another date
error.unsupportedQueryVersion: Unsupported search version. Check qv in the link
error.mixedQueryProtocol: The link mixes old and new filters. Remove legacy filter parameters
error.invalidPagination: Page must be 1–100000; page size must be 20, 50 or 100
error.searchProtocolMismatch: Search service version mismatch. Update the server and retry
error.invalidParameter: Invalid or repeated query parameter. Check the shared link
